verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes a PCB component-selection constraint to reduce JLCPCB Extended-part assembly fees.
The client changes the PCB design strategy to one integrated board with fewer connectors and a preference for JLCPCB Basic components while retaining functionality.
The client accepts use of JLCPCB Advanced components when suitable Basic components are unavailable.

value_updates.development_build_cost_exception: accept approximately $4 higher per-board assembly cost for through-hole connectors on development boards

verdicts.decision_note: The client creates a development-board manufacturing-cost exception for through-hole connectors; the connector assembly style itself belongs to the narrower assembly-style Requirement.
